notes.title: Update Ver1.0.4
notes.notes: [p]The following updates have been implemented.[/p][p]・Fixed a bug where dummy images weren't masked when “Change Appearance”[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45565070/f48b98cccb19cd29aff9321a254170275c541104.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Update Ver1.0.3
notes.notes: [p]The following updates have been implemented.[/p][p]・Added the ability to change character colors after creation[/p][p]・Added the ability to change equipment at the Adventurers' Guild[/p][p]・Added the ability to view the Item Index anywhere[/p][p]・Added the ability to check monster stats during battle[/p][p]・Changed so characters blown away by enemy monsters' “gust of wind” return to the party immediately after battle[/p][p]・Shortened the effect when using “Slash” on the field[/p][p]・Changed the design of the icon indicating your current location on the map[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45565070/f48b98cccb19cd29aff9321a254170275c541104.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Update Ver1.0.2
notes.notes: [p]The following updates have been implemented.[/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where “Crude medicine” could not be used on the field under certain conditions[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the power of the “Fighter” skill ‘Charge’[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed so that the “Unlock Door” skill automatically activates when touching a key door[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the map UI[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45565070/ac5f978ea9a478890906cd0bcb9bf4161e39f414.png"][/img][/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Update Ver1.0.1
notes.notes: [p]The following updates have been implemented.[/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where doors not within the player's field of view were mapped[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some UI glitches during combat[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where BGM would not play after using “Onsoku”[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where “Elixir” and “Crude medicine” could not be used in the field[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Undead afflicted with status ailments were not affected by ‘Dispel’ and “Disenchant”[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the “Unlock Door” skill could still be used to force open doors even if the user was incapacitated.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with message display when attempting to remove cursed equipment.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where rapidly pressing keys during a saved game load could corrupt the data.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the order of held items would sometimes become scrambled.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where spell effects were not displayed when using books.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the current quantity of items was not displayed when buying or selling items.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted item drop rates.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted parameters and spawn rates for “Dark Hero”.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed the drop item for “Dancing Coin”.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed character creation to highlight insufficient stats in red.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed ‘Onsoku’ to be usable only once per battle.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the extinguishing speed of “Torch”.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Early Game Strategy Guide Released
notes.notes: [p]A strategy guide for the early stages of Crescent Tower, including tips on job changes, has been released by developer “[url="https://store.steampowered.com/search/?developer=Curry%20Croquette&snr=1_5_9__2000"]Curry Croquette[/url].”[/p][p][url="https://currycroquette.com/2025/08/24/crescent-tower-%ef%bd%9e%e3%82%af%e3%83%ac%e3%82%bb%e3%83%b3%e3%83%88%e3%83%bb%e3%82%bf%e3%83%af%e3%83%bc%ef%bd%9e-%e6%94%bb%e7%95%a5%e8%a8%98%e4%ba%8b/"]Crescent Tower Strategy Guide[/url][/p][p]*The article is in Japanese, so please use machine translation to read it.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45565070/b9b331f647e118acccf7f81817e69dfcb8266a88.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Retail version of Steam's “Crescent Tower” is available today !
notes.notes:
[p][b]What is "Crescent Tower"?[/b] [/p][p]- A story woven from courage -[/p][p]A fusion of nostalgia and novelty awaits you! [/p][p]An authentic 8-bit style dungeon crawler RPG packed with retro style, intended for the 8-bit console generation and all RPG fans![/p][p][/p][p][b]Story[/b] [/p][p]Crescent Tower, an unprecedented dungeon that appears just once every 50 years in the Imperial Capital Mayirdoam.[/p][p]No one knows what lies at the top, yet rumors abound of a jewel that grants any wish the heart desires and of a potion of immortality. To finally discover what lies at the top of such a mysterious tower, nameless adventurers flock to Mayirdoam....[/p][p]You were one of those brave souls who set out to venture into this Crescent Tower.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Gameplay mechanics[/b] [/p][list][*][p]Simple turn-based battles[/p][p]Easy to pick up but highly strategic turn-based battles. Pixel art characters wage combat on a side-view battle screen![/p][/*][*][p]Choose a character from 3 races x 9 classes[/p][p]Freely create your own character from 3 races and 9 classes (jobs) at the Adventurers' Guild! Your character will grow ever stronger by repeatedly changing jobs while transferring skills already learned.[/p][/*][*][p]View all 10 levels of the dungeon from a 2D top-down perspective[/p][p]Explore all 10 levels of the dungeon from a 2D, top-down perspective. The search area around you will expand by lighting torches to ensure visibility. [/p][/*][*][p]The dungeon is filled with traps and mysteries... map it out as you proceed![/p][p]The 10-level dungeon is littered with various traps. The key to success is to advance while mapping out the area a little bit at a time.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Game length[/b][/p][p]10 – 20 hours on average[/p][p][/p][p][b]System Requirements[/b] [/p][p]· Minimum [/p][p]    ◦ OS: Windows 11 [/p][p]    ◦ Processor: AMD Ryzen™ 3 7320U / Intel® Core™ i3-1305U [/p][p]    ◦ Memory: 8 GB RAM [/p][p]    ◦ Graphics: AMD Radeon™ 610M / Intel® UHD Graphics [/p][p]    ◦ DirectX: Version 12 [/p][p]    ◦ Storage: 1 GB of available space[/p][p][/p][p][b]Factsheet(Retail version)[/b]
